gh-dial.label: The dial
gh-dial.map: The dial by the Chiapothecary door

garden-door.label: The garden door
garden-door.closed: The garden's for another day. You can see most of it from here.

plant-lavender.label: Lavender
plant-lavender.moment: Run your hand over it and you'll smell it for hours.

plant-rosemary.label: Rosemary
plant-rosemary.moment: Tough as old boots, this one. It stays green all winter.

plant-thyme.label: Thyme
plant-thyme.moment: Tiny leaves, lots of flavour. A sprig goes in nearly every soup I make.

plant-sage.label: Sage
plant-sage.moment: Soft as felt. Fry a few leaves in butter and you'll see why I grow it.

plant-mint.label: Peppermint
plant-mint.moment: Peppermint. It lives in its own pot, or it takes over everything.

plant-balm.label: Lemon balm
plant-balm.moment: Lemon balm. Crush a leaf and it smells of lemon sherbet.

plant-basil.label: Holy basil
plant-basil.moment: Holy basil, tulsi. Peppery, a bit like cloves. Lovely as a tea.

plant-chamomile.label: Chamomile
plant-chamomile.moment: Pick the flowers when they're fully open, and dry them for tea.

plant-calendula.label: Calendula
plant-calendula.moment: Pot marigold. The petals go in salads, and in balm for dry hands.

plant-echinacea.label: Echinacea
plant-echinacea.moment: The bees love it, and I leave the seed heads on for the birds.

plant-borage.label: Borage
plant-borage.moment: The flowers taste a bit like cucumber. Freeze them in ice cubes.

plant-fennel.label: Fennel
plant-fennel.moment: A few fennel seeds after dinner. My nan swore by it.

plant-ginger.label: Ginger
plant-ginger.moment: Ginger, in a deep pot. You lift the roots in autumn.

plant-turmeric.label: Turmeric
plant-turmeric.moment: Ginger's cousin. Same idea: the good part's under the soil.

plant-aloe.label: Aloe vera
plant-aloe.moment: Thick, cool leaves full of gel. Mind the edges, they're spiky.

plant-roselle.label: Hibiscus
plant-roselle.moment: Roselle. The red calyces make a sharp, ruby-red tea, hot or iced.

passionflower.label: Passionflower
passionflower.moment: It's been trying to lift the roof off for years.

nettle-bed.label: The nettle bed
nettle-bed.moment: Nettles, in a bed of their own. Gloves on. The young tops make a good soup.

seedlings.label: Seedlings
seedlings.moment: Whatever comes up gets potted on. Eventually.

seed-packets.label: Seed packets
seed-packets.moment: Next year's glasshouse, if I remember where I put them.

drying-herbs.label: Drying herbs
drying-herbs.moment: Bunches drying for the winter: lavender, rosemary, sage, whatever's spare.

wind-chime.label: The wind chime
wind-chime.moment: It rings when someone opens the garden door. Mostly that's me.

garden-view.label: The garden
garden-view.moment: The herb garden, then the wall, then the sea.

spring.label: Spring
spring.moment: Spring. Everything's in a hurry to grow.

summer.label: Summer
summer.moment: Summer. The bees have found the borage.

autumn.label: Autumn
autumn.moment: Autumn. Time to lift the ginger and hang up more bunches.

winter.label: Winter
winter.moment: Winter. Just the tough ones now: rosemary, thyme, sage and the aloe.
